WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) as total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) as min_consumption
  FROM customer_totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
  SELECT m.Segment, 
         ROUND(SUM(ct.total_consumption) / COUNT(*), 2) as annual_average
  FROM min_per_segment m
  JOIN customer_totals ct ON m.Segment = ct.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
  GROUP BY m.Segment
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_average END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_average END), 2) as diff_SME_LAM,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_average END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_average END), 2) as diff_LAM_KAM,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_average END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_average END), 2) as diff_KAM_SME
FROM avg_per_segment
